mtg-sdk	com.wingedsheep.sdk.serialization.SelfAlternativeChoiceLintTest	rejects a SELF_ALTERNATIVE read when the cost is explicitly null

mtg-sdk	com.wingedsheep.sdk.serialization.SelfAlternativeChoiceLintTest	does not declare SELF_ALTERNATIVE from a kicker cost

budgets.ci_rule: Only after all new local gates pass and immutable/live evidence readback passes; reconcile prior Candidate02 activation state before the single CI reservation. No historical counter reset.

admission: All frozen gates and exact original raw evidence required. A pass admits only bounded own-player/two-player Surge/Reckless Bushwhacker capability; neither whole-experiment completion nor Phase2 admission.
failure_rule: Preserve original partial outputs, exact failure, source restoration, and immutable/live readback. The new complete qualification is single-use; no silent rerun or unrelated source repair. Metadata/host preparation corrections must be explicit and preserve all semantic gates.
